features.note: The shell, dark roof, red facade band, circulation floor and translucent technical zones remain spatially separated, but the glass, tile, carpet and concrete do not yet read as distinct physical material classes in the neutral and grazing pixels.

The visible stepped red proxy volumes and dark corridor floor preserve the accepted room massing, but they read as uniform solid-color blocks rather than distinguishable burgundy upholstery, charcoal acoustic fabric and dark carpet. The shell-only evidence does not visually prove the full family material expectation.

The red/black/white facade identity is clear, yet the entrance glass reads mostly as dark voids, the public floor is a flat gray slab, and no convincing glass-versus-metal finish separation is visible. The shell-only captures do not prove later concession or kitchen material identities.

Green solid media and blue dashed/solid media remain color-distinct in engineering views, but endpoint families are communicated mainly by labels and glow rather than visibly different device materials, and stacked transparency reduces local readability in the grazing engineering capture.

All three paired views show a consistent shell: architecture remains opaque while engineering becomes sectioned/translucent with emissive green and blue media. The state distinction is visually unambiguous despite the weak architectural PBR read.

important_features.note: The 1.8 m figure, facade doors, corridor portal and large shell retain credible relative scale; small endpoint identities are carried by oversized labels rather than false geometry enlargement.
Bright exterior planes, red accents and dark corridor/auditorium zones establish a basic hierarchy, but the nearly unmodulated materials keep it schematic rather than convincingly commercial.
Engineering captures show continuous routed green and blue media through the sectioned shell, though overlapping translucent zones and labels obscure some local endpoint contacts.

defects: Across the neutral and grazing architecture captures, the warm-white walls, gray concrete/slabs, charcoal roof, red marquee and dark frames are dominated by flat base color with almost no distinct highlight shape; the grazing view therefore fails to expose the promised roughness differences.
The facade glazing reads primarily as opaque black openings in the neutral and grazing architecture pixels, not as transmissive blue-gray glass separated from charcoal mullions, portals and doors.

The broad gray public apron/slab, gray roof plate and white wall planes have nearly identical diffuse, textureless reads, so concrete, coated wall and roof finishes are distinguishable mostly by color and silhouette rather than PBR identity.
The red marquee and red shell-owned support/proxy elements remain uniformly saturated blocks without a painted-metal highlight response; their material read is close to matte plastic.

The public floor does not show the broad low-roughness reflection expected of lobby gloss tile, while the corridor floor is crushed to a nearly uniform black-purple plane; the two floor families do not remain convincingly identifiable across views.

The reference-match architecture view proves a corridor state but contains no facade glazing or marquee, while the grazing architecture view is filled by broad unmodulated planes; together the look-dev set does not provide persuasive cross-view evidence for the key shell material identities.

Engineering translucency and emissive media are clearly distinct from the opaque architecture state, but overlapping red zone volumes, gray shell layers and large labels become visually muddy in the grazing engineering capture.
corrections: Perform a Material Realism Reset on the shell-owned palette: calibrate concrete, coated warm-white wall, charcoal roof, red painted metal, facade glass, dark frames/portals and both floor families under the neutral rig before changing any later surface graphics or final lighting.

Make facade glass visibly transmissive in the saved neutral and grazing captures while keeping mullions and portal frames opaque charcoal; preserve a readable blue-gray reflection/transmission response instead of black voids.

Separate exterior concrete/slab from coated walls and roof through visibly different roughness and specular response: concrete should remain broad and diffuse, coated walls moderately matte, and the roof distinct rather than a featureless black absorber.

Give the red marquee and its shell-owned supports a controlled painted-metal clear specular lobe at grazing angles while keeping metalness near dielectric; do not solve this with emissive red or surface graphics.

Restore floor identity in neutral light: expose a restrained broad reflection on public/lobby tile and lift the dark corridor carpet enough to retain its matte burgundy-black read without flattening into black.

Re-capture the grazing architecture evidence with facade glass, marquee, frames, wall and slab all inside the useful image area so the saved pixels visibly demonstrate different highlight widths; keep the reference-match corridor view for interior floor verification.

Retain the current architecture-to-engineering state consistency and green-versus-blue media separation, but reduce transparency stacking/label dominance enough that shell layers and routed media remain readable in the grazing engineering view.

mechanical.note: Six current capture sidecars report console_clean=true with no issues. Probe medians are 152 draws and 22600 triangles against budgets of 550 and 750000; fps is informational only under SwiftShader.
